'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Angelo Consoli LS We'll Handle This (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Angelo Consoli]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This (V) / Duel Of The Fates (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
